responsibility: Implements GCC driver-side processing for LoongArch -m options. It records raw machine-option requests from specs, invokes the shared loongarch_config_target resolver, and returns a normalized self-spec string that rewrites or canonicalizes ABI, arch, tune, FPU, code-model, and floating-point mode switches before compilation and linking, including special handling when linking is suppressed.
same_name_distinction: Implements the driver-side handlers in the loongarch-driver pair: it records raw -m options from specs, calls the shared resolver, and builds the normalized self-spec option string. Unlike loongarch-driver.h, this is executable driver logic rather than spec-macro and prototype declarations.
